From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluecresthealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC2 evidence - employee screening & training

Hi Sean,

We're in the final stages of our SOC 2 assessment and the auditor has requested evidence around Redwood's employee screening and training for staff who have access to customer data. Specifically they asked for:

- Proof of criminal background checks or equivalent pre-hire screening for the last 12 months for new hires.
- A consolidated export of mandatory security awareness training completions (names, dates, course ids).
- A short summary of the onboarding and offboarding controls in place (who signs off, typical timelines).

Can you provide these items by EOD Tuesday 11/18? If there are any controls that are not documentable, please call them out.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Manager, Vendor Assurance
BlueCrest Health

Subject: Request: consolidated background check exports (Redwood hires, last 12 months)

Hi SecureHire team,

Per our contract please provide a consolidated export for Redwood hires who joined in the last 12 months. The auditor needs, at minimum, for each candidate: full name, date of birth (if you hold it), verification outcome (clear / adverse / pending), date performed, and a single-file PDF batch with the original report PDFs where available. We will redact sensitive fields before sending to the customer, but need the originals for audit purposes.

Scope:
- All hires with role types: engineering, platform, security, and account operations between 2024-11-01 and 2025-11-01.
- Preferred delivery: single ZIP containing CSV + PDFs.
- Delivery deadline: 2025-11-18 EOD (customer timeline).

Reference: internal PO #RH-2025-149.

If there are export size or compliance constraints, flag the records and we'll work through a secure transfer method (SharePoint/SSO-enabled drive or SFTP).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: None in this message

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>

Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence: employee background & training (BlueCrest Health)

Elena — attaching the package for your auditor. We have redacted PII in accordance with our data handling policy; if the auditor requires unredacted originals we can provision them over an encrypted SFTP link under a mutual NDA addendum.

Included in this package:
- background-checks-batch-2025-11-18.pdf (merged vendor reports; redacted)
- training-completions-2025-11-19.csv (export from LearnSecure; columns: name, employee_id (hashed), course_id, course_name, completion_date)
- onboarding-checklist-redwood-2025.pdf (internal onboarding & offboarding process flow, sign-off roles and typical timelines)

Summary of onboarding/offboarding controls (short):
- Pre-hire screening: all candidates in covered roles receive vendor background checks; verification step recorded by People Ops.
- Access provisioning: identity created in Okta upon start date; least-privilege access applied via role templates.
- Security training: mandatory security awareness + data handling course within first 7 days; completion tracked in LearnSecure and exported for audits.
- Offboarding: HR initiates deprovisioning ticket on last day; access revoked in Okta and SSO-integrated apps; ticket closure requires manager confirmation.

Attachments: 
- [attachment: background-checks-batch-2025-11-18.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)]
- [attachment: training-completions-2025-11-19.csv (csv, 45 KB)]
- [attachment: onboarding-checklist-redwood-2025.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

Let me know if you need the unredacted vendor PDFs or an export of access revocation logs for a specific employee.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
